overall: Monday (June 22) is expected to be a warm, partly sunny day with afternoon and evening thunderstorm chances developing after 11am, driven by southwest flow ahead of an approaching system. No active alerts affect the Atlanta area for tomorrow; the current Flood Advisory is confined to southwest Georgia and expires tonight.
